description: Speaking in the Assembly on August 19, Lokesh also asserted that environmental responsibility would be prioritised and defended the projects’ water and power requirements.
body_lead: Synopsis: Countering Lokesh’s statements, the HRF press release said, “The government’s own record, however, points to precisely the opposite conclusion, and the Minister’s assurances do not withstand scrutiny. How was environmental responsibility ‘prioritised’ when a hyperscale AI data center is being established virtually within the catchment of Mudasarlova reservoir, an important source of drinking water for Visakhapatnam?
